summary: Thomas Irwin, 73, of Indianapolis, Indiana, went missing after being last seen hiking the Petroglyph Point Trail on Jan 15; cellphone turned in to the park museum on Jan 16; intensive 10-day multi-agency search (NPS, local law enforcement, SAR teams) did not find him; occasional searches continued over the next year.
location: Petroglyph Point Trail, Mesa Verde National Park
responding_agency: NPS Mesa Verde; local law enforcement; search and rescue teams
notes: Disappearance date 2024-01-15 (Monday-verified); compendium reports 2024-01-24 (missing, search ongoing as of Jan 23) and 2025-03-05 follow-up: remains located 2025-02-28 (Friday-verified) by a human-remains-detection canine during an off-trail grid search, within the original search area. MERGE run 496: NPS Mar-3-2025 news release names the victim as Thomas Irwin of Indianapolis, Indiana — family reported him missing Jan 16 after he failed to return from the Petroglyph Point Trail; initial 10-day SAR effort; HRD canine located his remains Feb 28 2025 in an off-trail grid search within the original search area.
